title: Interactive Shiny-Based Grading Interface for Quarto and R Markdown Assignments
text: markermd Shiny-based grading environment assignments submitted git repositories containing Quarto (.qmd) documents (R Markdown .Rmd documents read way, mark(use_qmd = FALSE), since knitr-style chunk headers rewritten Quarto form parsing), classroom layouts produced ghclass’s org_grade_assignment(). submission parsed document tree (via q2r), validated structural requirements assignment, graded question question fast, hotkey-driven rubric interface. Everything (template, rubric, recorded grading) lives per-project SQLite database. package built around two apps: template() authors grading template: document sections questions, structural rules answer must satisfy. mark() grades collection student repositories template per-question rubrics. Around apps, set helper functions (validate_project(), parse_project(), scan_project(), template_import() / template_export(), rubric_import() / rubric_export() / rubric_item_set(), marks_import() / marks_export() / marks_set(), export_feedback()) makes entire workflow scriptable, bundled agent skills (Claude Code Codex) can scaffold template rubric, repair submissions strict parser rejects, apply rubric across submissions first pass human review.
